notes: Population, buildings, literacy, wealth, technology and military are V3 regional initialization templates, not EU5 economic conversion.
Province owner is selected by source population-weighted majority. Tiny countries may have no target territory; do not invent provinces for them.
Tribal governments in vanilla decentralized territory become decentralized only if they have no surviving dependency relationships.
Unowned habitable EU5 locations retain vanilla province ownership; wasteland and new target provinces inherit the nearest mapped province inside their target state.
Ruler age is preserved at the new start date. A source interregnum uses its active regent, explicitly recorded in the report.

Reviewed real country identities reuse installed V3 tags. Unmatched countries and dynamic subjects retain custom tags. Reuse does not import vanilla history; later tag-specific events remain a compatibility risk to audit.
Independent native tribal governments 182, 1069, 1092, 1093 and 1096 use decentralized country type; hereditary kingdoms and countries with dependency links remain centralized.
Retain the previously reviewed Piedmont/Provence territorial anchors over upstream coarse links.
